description: Researches YouTube videos from their real transcripts: pass video URLs in the task or in `urls`, or describe a topic and it finds relevant videos. Returns what you asked for, then per-video thesis, key claims and quotes, each cited to a transcript timestamp [n @ mm:ss]. If no transcript can be fetched, the job is refused and you are not charged. (x402: $0.03 USDC per call)
name: content.youtube-research
